about: A storage system that spreads files across many servers and lets apps reach them in several ways.

prs.title: File transfer listings no longer hang or come back short
prs.broken: SeaweedFS can serve files over SFTP, a common way to transfer files. If storage hiccupped during a folder listing, the server got stuck forever, and a single hidden file could cut a big listing short.
prs.changed: I made a storage error end the listing with a clear failure, and made hidden files stop cutting the listing short.
prs.matters: Users see every file they are allowed to see, or a clear error, never a silently partial list or a stuck server.
